pages.title: Welcome to meiCloud — All You Need
pages.text: $(bold)Friends-only ATM10 derivative$(reset)$(br)$(br)This pack adds 30+ mods to ATM10 7.0 — airships, cannons, trains, integrations, and a space chain.$(br)$(br)Live wiki: $(l:https://atm10.meicloud.net/wiki/)atm10.meicloud.net/wiki/$()

pages.title: Headliners
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Create: Aeronautics$()  Build airships and pilot them.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Create: Big Cannons$()  Mount artillery on your ships.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Steam'n'Rails$()  Real trains across biomes.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Creating Space$()  Build rockets, reach orbit.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Lithium + Sodium + Iris$()  Performance + shaders.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Distant Horizons$()  See chunks well past view distance.

pages.title: House rules
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)PvP is OFF.$()  Sword swings on other players do nothing.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Mob griefing is OFF.$()  Creepers don't blow up your base.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Hardcore-ish:$()  keepInventory is OFF, prepare for death.$(br)$(li)$(bold)View distance 14 / sim 12.$()  Your client may need to match.$(br)$(li)$(bold)8 max players.$()  Friends only.
